text:
jasmin: Proposal: let the edge perform a single midflight backend switch after detecting a streaming stall (>350ms idle frames). Edge keeps client stream open, forwards saved prefix to new backend. RFC stub: https://redwood.internal/rfc/edge-midflight-swap (WIP).

noah: big concern = ordering & duplication for side-effecting ops. We need a dedupe header or deny switching for non-idempotent routes.

ravi: we can generate `x-rw-requeue-id` at the edge and send it to upstream. Upstreams that opt-in keep a tiny cache (TTL ~2s) to detect dupes and return 409. For legacy ones, fallback to hedging.

jasmin: SKU for models: recommend disabling swap for families with heavy KV warm costs. eng-runtime, can you supply tagging for model warmup cost?

eng-runtime: yes, we'll add model tags (warm_cost: low|medium|high). Also suggest a PROBE state where edge sends a lightweight prefix probe to candidate (no billing) to check KV readiness before switching.

noah: probe reduces token waste but adds control-plane calls. Also we must cap switches to 1 per request to avoid loops.

sre: ops: require a global per-instance requeue budget and metrics: `edge.swap.attempt`, `edge.swap.success`, `edge.swap.dup`, `edge.swap.fallback`. Alert if fallback > 0.5% in 5m.

jasmin: rollout plan: feature-flag `edge.midflight_swap` off by default. Phase 1 internal canary idempotent-only. Phase 2 opt-in upstreams advertise `x-rw-requeue-capable`.

deploy-bot: Feature flag `edge.midflight_swap` created (off).

ravi: SDKs should expose `requeue.attempted` events and make behavior predictable: client should see either uninterrupted stream or an explicit error; avoid silent restarts.

jasmin: I'll draft RFC with state machine (IDLE->STALLED->PROBE->SWITCH->FINALIZE/FAIL), header contract, telemetry, and perf experiments. Ping @eng-runtime @sre for numbers.
